manualTasks.title: Cancel or retain the unused Apify subscription.
manualTasks.plain: No current DNESKAi article source needs Apify. Cancellation needs the owner's instruction; if retained for a future approved source, review the $24 hard usage limit because recurring included credit is $19 (invoice $22.99 with tax). The extra $5 promotion expires 16 October.

manualTasks.title: Record actual provider payments in the treasury ledger.
manualTasks.plain: The owner supplies amounts/currency and dates for fal.ai credit, Anthropic credit and Apify invoices; do not substitute advertised prices or estimated usage for payments.

manualTasks.title: Delete the merged session branches.
manualTasks.plain: The git relay refuses remote branch deletes (it hangs up on git push --delete). Delete these merged branches on GitHub: claude/amazing-hawking-gu086p (merged through #604 and #608).

manualTasks.title: Resume DNESKAi articles when you want them back.
manualTasks.plain: You paused them on 2026-10-20 (state/decisions/2026-10-20-dneskai-articles-paused.md); reviews, editions and images are all kept. To resume: switch Caught Up back on in Settings, or set "status": "operating" and delete pausedOn in config/ventures.json. Add cu-day, cu-edition and cu-product back to the workflow_dispatch options in .github/workflows/cycle.yml and restore the cu-day and cu-edition en
